newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sells extra 3.01 bln Ffr OATs after auction.
newsitem.headline: France sells extra 3.01 bln Ffr OATs after auction.

text.p: The Treasury said on Friday it sold a further 3.008 billion francs of OATs, increasing the total nominal value of bonds sold this week to 25.260 billion.

NOTE - The Treasury originally announced it would sell 21 to 23 billion francs of OATs in total. The total bid cover ratio of the auction was 2.5.

Under the French system, primary dealers and central banks not only submit competitive bids at the auction, but also have the option, for a limited period after the sale, of buying extra bonds at the average auction price.
